result.summary: Found several layout and content issues: overlapping text on a restaurant card, a truncated restaurant name, and overlapping delivery/type labels that harm readability.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery time text ('25-30') overlaps or collides with the word 'delivery', rendering as garbled text like '25-30delivery'.
issues.suggestion: Fix spacing/layout so delivery time and the 'delivery' label do not overlap; ensure proper gap or separate lines if needed.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you section.
issues.suggestion: Allow the name to wrap to two lines, use a shorter display name, or ensure the card width accommodates the full title without clipping.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the cuisine type 'Ramen' sits too close to or collides with the delivery info on the same line.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer separation (bullet spacing, margin, or stacking) between delivery time and cuisine category.
